fns.desc: ndis_events_get_adapter: if IWbemClassObject_Get(pObj,"Index",...) fails (:546-552), function releases pSvc and returns but never calls IWbemClassObject_Release(pObj) -- COM object refcount leak on this error path (contrast with the analogous round2/round3 failure paths at :590,611,625,644,666,672,678,691 which all correctly release pObj/pEnumerator).

ndis_events_indicate: on MSNdis_NotifyAdapterArrival, calls ndis_events_get_adapter(events, events->ifname, NULL) without checking its return value (:345). ndis_events_get_adapter unconditionally frees events->adapter_desc and sets it NULL at entry (:503-504); if the WMI re-query and the desc==NULL fallback in ndis_events_use_desc both fail, events->adapter_desc remains NULL, and the very next statement, wcscmp(events->adapter_desc, vt.bstrVal) (:348), dereferences it -- NULL pointer dereference on the WMI notification path when an adapter re-query fails after an arrival event.

ndis_events_media_specific: SafeArrayGetLBound(:262)/SafeArrayGetUBound(:263) return values are discarded; lower/upper are plain LONG locals with no initializer. If either call fails, lower/upper are used uninitialized to compute data_len = upper-lower+1 (:264) and to bound the k=lower..upper copy loop (:274-277), which can yield a huge/garbage data_len feeding os_malloc() and an out-of-bounds SafeArrayGetElement/*pos++ write loop -- unchecked-return-value leading to a potential heap buffer overflow driven by untrusted NDIS status-indication data.
